canada.title: Jury in coroner's inquest hears how woman from Alberta died in northwestern Ontario
canada.summary: The first day of a coroner's inquest into the death of a woman at Lake of the Woods District Hospital in Kenora, Ont., took place via video conference on Monday. Here's what members of the jury heard about the late Kaylee Martha Dallas Crowchild of Tsuut’ina Nation in southern Alberta and how she ended up in northwestern Ontario.

canada.title: Fear, outrage grow as Quebec moves to ban religious symbols for elementary students
canada.summary: Quebec parents of young children who wear religious symbols are worried about the new PQ government’s proposal to ban elementary school students from wearing such symbols at school. Experts say there is no justification for the ban and that it would be harmful.

canada.title: Pride and Gender Equity Centre to host Transgender Day of Remembrance event in Thunder Bay, Ont.
canada.summary: The Lakehead University Student Union’s Pride and Gender Equity Centre is hosting a Transgender Day of Remembrance event at The Study Coffeehouse on Nov. 21. The on-campus event will provide a space for Thunder Bay and northwestern Ontario residents to gather, pay their respects and remember those they care about and who were lost in the community.

canada.title: 'We want to give them a sense of comfort': Sept-Îles, Que., warming shelter opens for 3rd winter
canada.summary: For the third year in a row, Dominique Leclerc and her colleagues at Sept-Îles, Que., crisis centre Le Rond-Point are manning the city's only infrastructure for the unhoused, a temporary warming centre — a necessity in a community located north of the 50th parallel, where there is often snow on the ground until the beginning of May.

canada.title: Survivor of fatal boat crash near Squamish speaks out
canada.summary: Spencer Seabrooke, a survivor of a fatal boat crash near Squamish, B.C., on Thursday, is speaking out about his experience. Three people died in the crash.
